snippet.title: STRANGER THAN HEAVEN - Announcement Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
The official title of Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio's "Project Century" announced at The Game Awards 2024 has been revealed as STRANGER THAN HEAVEN. 

STRANGER THAN HEAVEN is a brand-new title developed by Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio, known for creating acclaimed series such as Yakuza™, Like a Dragon™ and Virtua Fighter™.

▼ Summer Game Fest 2025: Title Reveal Teaser Trailer
https://youtu.be/5L3XVVzsmHE
